visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair tied back, wearing a light grey hoodie and navy blue trousers, lies flat on a white-sheeted bed in a modern hotel room. The head section of the bed begins to incline upwards, and she looks at the camera with a surprised and smiling expression. (2) A wide-angle shot shows the compact room's layout, featuring a dark grey padded wall with vertical ribs behind the bed and a projector mounted on the ceiling. (3) The scene cuts back to the woman laughing as the bed reaches a more upright angle. (4) A close-up displays a smartphone screen with a Japanese app interface used to control the bed's automatic wake-up settings. (5) The woman is shown lying flat again; then the mattress begins to fold automatically into a seated sofa-like position. (6) She sits on the fully elevated bed, waving and smiling directly at the lens. (7) A white projector screen lowers from a slot in the ceiling in front of the bed. (8) The woman uses a black remote to control the projection, which shows a colorful anime scene. (9) A montage follows: showing the storage space under the bed marked with 'luggage >' on the carpet, a wooden side cabinet with a black kettle, and a small white side table. (10) The bathroom is shown, featuring a modern white sink, a bidet-style toilet, and a glass shower stall. (11) The hotel lobby/lounge is showcased with long wooden tables, hanging circular lights, and a blue neon-lit bar. (12) A self-serve coffee machine and 24-hour drink station are briefly shown. (13) The video ends with a pink and white graphic card featuring the 'japanuts.com' logo and social media icons.
